title: Firearm Volume 1 - #4 December 1993 Malibu Comics Ultraverse Break-Thru
descriptionText: The product is a comic book from the Firearm series, specifically issue number 4 from December 1993. Malibu Comics published this Ultraverse Break-Thru comic, featuring artwork and writing by James Robinson, John Lowe, and Cully Hamner. This collectible item is a part of US Comics tradition and revolves around the main character Firearm. Fans of comic books and graphic novels from the 1990s may appreciate this piece of comic book history.
